title: Track Guide Okayama - Full Mazda MX5 iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Brake at tire marks or lose cone from FOV, 90-95% pressure
corners.line: Turn-in at marker, apex at top of corner, on curb
corners.exit: Go on throttle as soon as on curb, use as much track as needed

corners.label: T2
corners.line: Go on throttle to steer, use curb on outside
corners.exit: Full throttle once curb visible, use curb to carry speed

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Brake hard at first tower, 90-95% before easing into trail brake to curb.
corners.line: Later apex, aim for middle of track.
corners.exit: Full throttle, get car to right for turn six.

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: Quick hit to 25%, aim for inside curb.

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: Quick hit to 25%, aim for inside curb

corners.label: T7
corners.line: Apex after midway, take inside curb
corners.mistakes: Spinning due to gravel on outside

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: Fence on left, 90-95% brake pressure, trail brake to curb
corners.line: Apex top of corner, exit middle of track
turn-in to curb, apex on curb

general_tips: For turn one, use left side of track for overtaking in race.
For turn four, use dirt patch for qualifying.
